idea-plugin.name: Auto-Renewal Signup Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Sixteen statutory checks on the signup page AB 2863 rewrote, in your editor and in the browser

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Auto-Renewal Signup Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 16 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/autorenew-signup-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/autorenew-signup-lint

action.text: Auto-Renewal Signup Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Auto-Renewal Signup Lint on the file in the editor
